offering_description.value: Provides merchant payment processing and B2B payment software to small and mid-sized businesses. It processes card and ACH payments and automates business payables, delivered through point-of-sale hardware, software platforms and merchant accounts.

primary_products.value: payment terminals; payment processing software; B2B payment platform

primary_services.value: payment processing; merchant acquiring; accounts payable automation

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized merchants, restaurants, healthcare providers, and businesses paying suppliers

end_markets.value: restaurants and hospitality; healthcare; professional services; retail; business-to-business payments

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: card and ACH processing fees charged to merchants and business payers; service fees: software, platform and integration fees
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: routes payments between merchants, card networks, banks and suppliers, taking fees on volume; software / platform: sells payment software and payables platforms to businesses

geography_served.value: US national: Nationwide across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: merchant payment processing, B2B payment software, accounts payable automation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling to merchants and businesses; partners / resellers: independent sales organizations and software integration partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: card network rules, PCI data security standards, and banking and money transmission rules
